grade.message: My Lufthansa flight to Italy (LHR05A) was hours late so my fiancee got to the Amalfi hotel alone and they would not check her in. After two hours on the phone the Hilton diamond desk told me to cancel the reservation (AMF-50512) and promised me five times I would not be charged. Twenty minutes later I was charged $2,586.56. Another Hilton person said they would review the call and send me a check in 7 days. It has been 45 days. I want the $2,586.56 back and whatever Lufthansa owes me for the delay. marco.bellini@example.com, card 4505.
